We need propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have a template (id 29646) that seems to deprotect TBS? Actually retro template: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]' This is reverse of protecting: it breaks Si-O bond to give alcohol and TBS group. Applying to target gave three possible precursors: each with TBS attached to different OH? The results: three SMILES with TBS on different OH positions. Let's capture them.

Result list: 
1) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO
2) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C
3) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO

So target has three OH groups: a primary alcohol (CH2OH), a secondary alcohol on the ring, and a carboxylic acid (actually C(O)=O). The TBS protecting group likely on one of them. In retrosynthesis we need 5 steps. Likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS to give free OH. 2) Use Still-Gennari/HWE to form the conjugated diene chain from an aldehyde and phosphonate. 3) Use DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde. 4) Protect alcohols with TBS. 5) Build the cyclohexane core maybe via dihydroxylation? Might be complex.

We can propose a plausible route using known transformations: Starting from simple building blocks: (a) a cyclohexanol derivative (maybe from cyclohexanone reduction). (b) side chain from (E)-but-2-enoic acid etc.

Given limited tool, we can construct route using templates we have. We have template 29646 for deprotection. Need other templates: maybe HWE (Still-Gennari) template? Search for functional groups broken: "aldehydes" formed "C-C double bonds". Let's search for Still-Gennari template.
